name: Shenzhou 8 Guidao Cang
about: Shenzhou 8 Guidao Cang (2011-063D), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou OM), launched 2011 Oct 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).
